source.text: Κεφάλαιον δὲ ἐπὶ τοῖς λεγομένοις, τοιοῦτον ἔχομεν ἀρχιερέα, ὃς ἐκάθισεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ θρόνου τῆς μεγαλωσύνης ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς, τῶν ἁγίων λειτουργὸς καὶ τῆς σκηνῆς τῆς ἀληθινῆς, ἣν ἔπηξεν ὁ κύριος, οὐκ ἄνθρωπος.

records.literal_gloss: [The] main point now upon the things being said: such we have high priest, who sat down at [the] right of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens, \v 2 of the holy [places] minister and of the tent the true, which pitched the Lord, not man.

en.L: Now [the] chief point in the things being said [is this]: we have such a high priest, who sat down at [the] right [hand] of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens, \v 2 a minister of the holy place and of the true tent, which the Lord pitched, not {{gender:a human being|man}}.
en.B: Here is the heart of what we are saying. Our high priest is one who has taken {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} seat at the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in heaven, \v 2 and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} serves in the sanctuary, the true tabernacle, pitched by the Lord and not by {{gender:a human being|man}}.
en.R: Here is the main point of what we are saying. We have this kind of high priest. He sat down in heaven at the right side of the throne of God, the great King. \v 2 There {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} serves in the sanctuary, in the true sacred tent. The Lord set up this tent, not any human being.

es.L: Ahora bien, [el] punto principal de lo que se está diciendo [es este]: tenemos tal sumo sacerdote, que se sentó a [la] derecha del trono de la Majestad en los cielos, \v 2 ministro del lugar santo y de la tienda verdadera, que levantó el Señor, no {{gender:un ser humano|el hombre}}.
es.B: Este es el centro de lo que estamos diciendo. Nuestro sumo sacerdote es uno que ha tomado asiento a la derecha del trono de la Majestad en el cielo, \v 2 y sirve en el santuario, el verdadero tabernáculo, levantado por el Señor y no por {{gender:un ser humano|el hombre}}.
es.R: Este es el punto principal de lo que decimos. Tenemos un sumo sacerdote así. Se sentó en el cielo, a la derecha del trono de Dios, el gran Rey. \v 2 Allí sirve en el santuario, en la verdadera tienda sagrada. El Señor levantó esta tienda, no ningún ser humano.

fr.L: Or [le] point principal dans ce qui est dit [est ceci] : nous avons un tel grand prêtre, qui s’est assis à [la] droite du trône de la Majesté dans les cieux, \v 2 ministre du lieu saint et de la vraie tente, que le Seigneur a dressée, et non {{gender:un être humain|l’homme}}.
fr.B: Voici l’essentiel de ce que nous disons. Notre grand prêtre est celui qui a pris place à la droite du trône de la Majesté dans les cieux, \v 2 et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sert dans le sanctuaire, le vrai tabernacle, dressé par le Seigneur et non par {{gender:un être humain|l’homme}}.
fr.R: Voici le point principal de ce que nous disons. Nous avons un grand prêtre de ce genre. Il s’est assis dans le ciel, à droite du trône de Dieu, le grand Roi. \v 2 Là, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sert dans le sanctuaire, dans la vraie tente sacrée. C’est le Seigneur qui a dressé cette tente, et non un être humain.

sw.L: Basi kiini cha mambo yanayosemwa [ni hiki]: tunaye kuhani mkuu wa namna hii, aliyeketi upande wa kulia wa kiti cha enzi cha Ukuu mbinguni, \v 2 mhudumu wa mahali patakatifu na wa hema halisi, ambayo Bwana aliisimika, si mwanadamu.
sw.B: Hiki ndicho kiini cha tunachosema: kuhani wetu mkuu ni yule aliyeketi upande wa kulia wa kiti cha enzi cha Ukuu mbinguni, \v 2 naye anahudumu katika patakatifu, yaani hema halisi, iliyosimikwa na Bwana wala si na mwanadamu.
sw.R: Hili ndilo jambo kuu tunalosema. Tunaye kuhani mkuu wa namna hii. Aliketi mbinguni upande wa kulia wa kiti cha enzi cha Mungu, Mfalme mkuu. \v 2 Huko anahudumu katika mahali patakatifu, ndani ya hema takatifu halisi. Bwana ndiye aliyesimika hema hii, si mwanadamu yeyote.

vi.L: Vậy, điểm chính trong những điều đang nói [là đây]: chúng ta có một thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm như thế, là Đấng đã ngồi bên phải ngai của Đấng Uy Nghiêm trên các tầng trời, \v 2 là người phục vụ nơi thánh và lều thật, là lều do Chúa dựng nên, không phải do loài người.
vi.B: Đây là điểm cốt lõi của những gì chúng ta đang nói: thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm của chúng ta là Đấng đã ngồi bên phải ngai của Đấng Uy Nghiêm trên trời, \v 2 và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phục vụ trong nơi thánh, tức là đền tạm thật, do Chúa dựng nên chứ không phải do loài người.
vi.R: Đây là điểm chính của những gì chúng ta đang nói. Chúng ta có một thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm như thế. Ngài đã ngồi xuống trên trời, bên phải ngai của Đức Chúa Trời, là Vua vĩ đại. \v 2 Tại đó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phục vụ trong nơi thánh, trong lều thánh thật. Chúa đã dựng nên lều này, chứ không phải con người.

ko.L: 지금 우리가 말하고 있는 것들의 요점은 이것입니다. 우리에게는 이러한 대제사장이 계십니다. 그분은 하늘에서 위엄의 보좌 오른쪽에 앉으셨고, \v 2 성소와 참 장막에서 섬기시는 분이십니다. 그 장막은 사람이 아니라 주님께서 세우신 것입니다.
ko.B: 우리가 말하고 있는 것의 핵심은 이것입니다. 우리의 대제사장은 하늘에 계신 존엄하신 분의 보좌 오른쪽에 앉으신 분입니다. \v 2 그분은 성소, 곧 참 성막에서 섬기십니다. 그 성막은 사람이 아니라 주님께서 세우신 것입니다.
ko.R: 우리가 말하고 있는 것의 가장 중요한 점은 이것입니다. 우리에게는 이런 대제사장이 계십니다. 그분은 하늘에서 위대한 왕이신 하나님의 보좌 오른쪽에 앉으셨습니다. \v 2 그분은 거기 성소, 곧 참된 거룩한 장막에서 섬기십니다. 이 장막은 사람이 아니라 주님께서 세우셨습니다.

pt.L: Ora, o ponto principal do que está sendo dito [é este]: temos um sumo sacerdote assim, que se sentou à direita do trono da Majestade nos céus, \v 2 ministro do lugar santo e da tenda verdadeira, que o Senhor armou, não {{gender:um ser humano|o homem}}.
pt.B: Este é o ponto central do que estamos dizendo: o nosso sumo sacerdote é aquele que tomou assento à direita do trono da Majestade no céu, \v 2 e ali {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} serve no santuário, o verdadeiro tabernáculo, armado pelo Senhor e não por {{gender:um ser humano|um homem}}.
pt.R: Este é o ponto principal do que estamos dizendo. Nós temos um sumo sacerdote assim. Ele se sentou no céu, ao lado direito do trono de Deus, o grande Rei. \v 2 Lá {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} serve no santuário, na verdadeira tenda sagrada. Foi o Senhor que armou essa tenda, e não um ser humano.

am.L: ስለምንናገረው ነገር ዋናው ነጥብ ይህ ነው፤ በሰማያት ባለው በግርማዊው ዙፋን ቀኝ የተቀመጠ እንዲህ ያለ ሊቀ ካህናት አለን፤ \v 2 እርሱም የመቅደሱና ሰው ሳይሆን ጌታ የተከለው የእውነተኛው ድንኳን አገልጋይ ነው።
am.B: የምንናገረው ነገር ዋና ቁም ነገሩ ይህ ነው፤ ሊቀ ካህናታችን በሰማይ በግርማዊው ዙፋን ቀኝ የተቀመጠ ነው፤ \v 2 እርሱም በመቅደሱ፣ ሰው ሳይሆን ጌታ በተከለው በእውነተኛው ድንኳን ያገለግላል።
am.R: የምንናገረው ዋናው ነጥብ ይህ ነው፤ እንዲህ ያለ ሊቀ ካህናት አለን። እርሱ በሰማይ በታላቁ ንጉሥ በእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ቀኝ ተቀመጠ። \v 2 በዚያም በመቅደሱ፣ በእውነተኛው የተቀደሰ ድንኳን ውስጥ ያገለግላል። ይህን ድንኳን የተከለው ጌታ ነው እንጂ ማንም ሰው አይደለም።

decisions.choice: the main point: the chief thing, the heart of the matter
alternatives: a summary of all that has been said
decisions.reason: Κεφάλαιον can mean a summary or the chief point. The author is not summing up chapters 1-7 but pointing to what matters most: where our high priest now serves.

decisions.choice: Psalm 110:1 (109:1 Greek): seated at God's right hand
decisions.reason: The words echo Psalm 110:1, "Sit at my right hand", which Hebrews quoted in 1:13 and alluded to in 1:3. "The Majesty" (μεγαλωσύνης) is a reverent way of naming God, as in 1:3.

decisions.choice: the holy place: the sanctuary where God dwells, here the heavenly one
decisions.reason: ἁγίων is plural ("of the holy [places]"), but in Hebrews the plural regularly means the sanctuary, especially its inmost part (9:8, 9:12, 9:24, 10:19). The genitive could also be read "holy things", but the parallel "the true tent" points to a place.

decisions.choice: true: the real and original tent, of which the earthly one is a copy
decisions.reason: ἀληθινῆς means "genuine, real". The tent Moses made was not false; it was a copy and shadow of the heavenly reality (8:5; 9:24).

decisions.choice: which the Lord pitched: perhaps an echo of Numbers 24:6 in Greek ("like tents which the Lord pitched")
decisions.reason: The verb ἔπηξεν is the ordinary word for pitching a tent. The Greek of Numbers 24:6 has the phrase "tents which the Lord pitched", which may lie behind the wording. Moses pitched the earthly tent (Exodus 33:7); God himself made the true one.

decisions.choice: tent (Literal); tabernacle (Balanced); sacred tent (Readable)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for σκηνή in Hebrews.

decisions.choice: the holy place (Literal); the sanctuary (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for the sanctuary in Hebrews.

decisions.choice: the throne of God, the great King
decisions.reason: Readable says who "the Majesty" is.

decisions.choice: tienda (Literal); tabernáculo (Balanced); tienda sagrada (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled terms for Hebrews, matching the English (r-en-1): Literal shows the plain word for a tent, Balanced the familiar name of Israel's sacred tent, Readable says what it was.

decisions.choice: {{gender:un ser humano|el hombre}}
decisions.reason: The contrast is between God and any human being; the reader can choose the traditional "el hombre". Spanish needs no pronoun for "he" or "his" in this sentence, so the English deity-pronoun spans have no counterpart.

decisions.choice: mahali patakatifu (Literal, Readable), patakatifu (Balanced); hema (Literal, Balanced), hema takatifu (Readable)
decisions.reason: The book-wide Swahili words for the sanctuary and the tent. "Hekalu" is the temple in Jerusalem, which Hebrews does not describe. "Halisi" (genuine, real) for "true" says that the earthly tent was a copy, not that it was false.

decisions.choice: Ukuu
decisions.reason: "The Majesty" is a reverent name for God, as in 1:3, written with a capital. "Utukufu" is kept for "glory"; "Adhama" (grandeur) is a possible alternative.

decisions.choice: mwanadamu, no setting
decisions.reason: "Mwanadamu" is a human being, man or woman, so the English gender span has no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: le lieu saint (Literal), le sanctuaire (Balanced, Readable); la tente (Literal), le tabernacle (Balanced), la tente sacrée (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled French terms for Hebrews, level by level as in English (rendering decisions r-en-1 and r-en-2). "Tabernacle" is the established French word for Israel's sacred tent; Readable says plainly what it was.

decisions.choice: {{gender:un être humain|l’homme}}; a pris place with no possessive
decisions.reason: The traditional French for "not man" is generic "l'homme", so that is the alternative to the inclusive default. Balanced says "a pris place" for "has taken his seat", which needs no possessive, so it has no deity_pronoun span there.

decisions.choice: "lều" (L); "đền tạm" (B); "lều thánh" (R) for the tent, through 8:2-9:21; "nơi thánh" for the sanctuary
decisions.reason: The tent is the tabernacle, the real one in heaven and its earthly copy (m4). Literal keeps the plain "lều", as the English keeps "tent"; Balanced uses "đền tạm", the church word for the tabernacle; Readable says "sacred tent", as the English Readable does. "Nơi thánh" is the word of the Vietnamese Luke (1:8-9) for the sanctuary. "Loài người" takes no gender span.

decisions.choice: "장막" (L), "성막" (B), "거룩한 장막" (R) for the tent; "성소" for the holy place, through chapters 8-10
decisions.reason: The word means a tent, and at Balanced it names the tabernacle (meaning decision; the English has tent, tabernacle, sacred tent). Korean has the same three choices: the plain word, the established name "성막", and a description. "성소" is the sanctuary, as in the Korean Matthew 27:51; no gender span is needed for "사람".

decisions.choice: a tenda (L); o tabernáculo (B); a tenda sagrada (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, following the English per level. "Tabernáculo" is the word Brazilian readers know for the tent of Exodus, but it hides that the Greek word is the ordinary word for a tent, which Literal keeps; Readable says "tenda sagrada" so a new reader sees both the tent and its purpose.

decisions.choice: o lugar santo (L); o santuário (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, as the English: the plural means the sanctuary (m3), so Literal says "o lugar santo" and Balanced and Readable "o santuário".

decisions.choice: ድንኳን (tent, tabernacle) at every level, through Hebrews 8-9
decisions.reason: Hebrews pictures the wilderness tent; ድንኳን is that word in Amharic and the church's name for the tabernacle, so one word serves all three English choices (tent, tabernacle, sacred tent). Readable adds የተቀደሰ (sacred) where the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: መቅደስ (sanctuary, holy place)
decisions.reason: መቅደስ means a holy place and names the sanctuary at every level; ቤተ መቅደስ is kept for the Jerusalem temple, which Hebrews does not speak of. The not-human builder is ሰው, which needs no gender span.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Amharic in this chapter.

source.text: πᾶς γὰρ ἀρχιερεὺς εἰς τὸ προσφέρειν δῶρά τε καὶ θυσίας καθίσταται· ὅθεν ἀναγκαῖον ἔχειν τι καὶ τοῦτον ὃ προσενέγκῃ.

records.literal_gloss: Every for high priest for the to offer gifts both and sacrifices is appointed; wherefore necessary to have something also this [one] which he may offer.

en.L: For every high priest is appointed for offering both gifts and sacrifices; hence [it is] necessary that this [one] too have something that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} may offer.
en.B: The task of every high priest is to present gifts and sacrifices, so our high priest too must have something to present.
en.R: Every high priest is chosen to give gifts and sacrifices to God. So Jesus, our high priest, must also have something to offer.

es.L: Porque todo sumo sacerdote es constituido para ofrecer dones y sacrificios; por lo cual [es] necesario que también este tenga algo que ofrecer.
es.B: La tarea de todo sumo sacerdote es presentar dones y sacrificios, así que también nuestro sumo sacerdote tiene que tener algo que presentar.
es.R: Todo sumo sacerdote es escogido para dar a Dios dones y sacrificios. Así que Jesús, nuestro sumo sacerdote, también tiene que tener algo que ofrecer.

fr.L: Car tout grand prêtre est établi pour offrir des dons et des sacrifices ; d’où [il est] nécessaire que celui-ci aussi ait quelque chose qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} puisse offrir.
fr.B: La tâche de tout grand prêtre est de présenter des dons et des sacrifices ; il faut donc que notre grand prêtre aussi ait quelque chose à présenter.
fr.R: Tout grand prêtre est choisi pour offrir à Dieu des dons et des sacrifices. Il faut donc que Jésus, notre grand prêtre, ait aussi quelque chose à offrir.

sw.L: Kwa maana kila kuhani mkuu huteuliwa kwa ajili ya kutoa zawadi na dhabihu pia; kwa sababu hiyo [ni] lazima kwamba huyu pia awe na kitu fulani atakachotoa.
sw.B: Kazi ya kila kuhani mkuu ni kuleta zawadi na dhabihu, kwa hiyo kuhani wetu mkuu pia lazima awe na kitu cha kuleta.
sw.R: Kila kuhani mkuu huchaguliwa ili kumpa Mungu zawadi na dhabihu. Kwa hiyo Yesu, kuhani wetu mkuu, lazima naye awe na kitu cha kutoa.

vi.L: Vì mọi thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm đều được lập để dâng cả lễ vật lẫn sinh tế; vì vậy Đấng này cũng cần phải có một điều gì để dâng.
vi.B: Nhiệm vụ của mọi thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm là dâng lễ vật và sinh tế, vì vậy thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm của chúng ta cũng phải có điều gì để dâng.
vi.R: Mọi thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm đều được chọn để dâng lễ vật và sinh tế lên Đức Chúa Trời. Vì vậy Đức Giê-xu, là thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm của chúng ta, cũng phải có điều gì để dâng.

ko.L: 모든 대제사장은 예물과 제물을 드리도록 세움을 받습니다. 그러므로 이분도 무엇인가 드릴 것이 있어야 합니다.
ko.B: 모든 대제사장이 맡은 일은 예물과 제물을 드리는 것입니다. 그러므로 우리의 대제사장께도 드릴 무엇인가가 있어야 합니다.
ko.R: 모든 대제사장은 하나님께 예물과 제물을 바치도록 뽑힙니다. 그러므로 우리의 대제사장이신 예수께도 바칠 것이 있어야 합니다.

pt.L: Pois todo sumo sacerdote é constituído para apresentar tanto ofertas como sacrifícios; por isso [é] necessário que também este tenha algo que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} possa oferecer.
pt.B: A tarefa de todo sumo sacerdote é apresentar ofertas e sacrifícios; por isso também o nosso sumo sacerdote precisa ter algo para apresentar.
pt.R: Todo sumo sacerdote é escolhido para dar ofertas e sacrifícios a Deus. Por isso Jesus, o nosso sumo sacerdote, também precisa ter algo para oferecer.

am.L: ሊቀ ካህናት ሁሉ መባንና መሥዋዕትን ለማቅረብ ይሾማልና፤ ስለዚህ ይህ ደግሞ የሚያቀርበው አንድ ነገር ሊኖረው ግድ ነው።
am.B: የሊቀ ካህናት ሁሉ ሥራ መባንና መሥዋዕትን ማቅረብ ነው፤ ስለዚህ ሊቀ ካህናታችንም የሚያቀርበው ነገር ሊኖረው ይገባል።
am.R: ሊቀ ካህናት ሁሉ የሚመረጠው ለእግዚአብሔር መባንና መሥዋዕትን እንዲያቀርብ ነው። ስለዚህ ሊቀ ካህናታችን ኢየሱስም የሚያቀርበው ነገር ሊኖረው ይገባል።

decisions.choice: gifts and sacrifices: all the offerings a high priest brought to God
decisions.reason: The pair appears in 5:1 and 9:9. It covers both offerings of grain and other gifts and animal sacrifices.

decisions.choice: it is necessary: the Greek has no verb; the single act of offering points to Jesus' one offering of himself
decisions.reason: The Greek says only "necessary", so "is" or "was" must be supplied. The aorist προσενέγκῃ points to one act of offering, which 7:27 has already named: he offered himself. The author does not say here what the offering was; chapters 9 and 10 do.

decisions.choice: our high priest; Jesus, our high priest
decisions.reason: "This one" is the high priest of verse 1, so Balanced and Readable say who he is.

decisions.choice: ofertas
decisions.reason: "Dons" today suggests talents, and "presentes" gifts between people; "ofertas" is the Portuguese word for what is brought to God, and keeps the pair "ofertas e sacrifícios" of m1.

source.text: εἰ μὲν οὖν ἦν ἐπὶ γῆς, οὐδ’ ἂν ἦν ἱερεύς, ὄντων τῶν προσφερόντων κατὰ νόμον τὰ δῶρα·

records.literal_gloss: If indeed then he were on earth, not even would he be priest, there being those offering according to law the gifts;

en.L: If then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} were on earth, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would not even be a priest, since there are those who offer the gifts according to law;
en.B: On earth {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would not even be a priest, for there are already men who present the gifts the law requires.
en.R: If Jesus were on earth, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would not be a priest at all. There are already priests here who offer the gifts that the law of Moses commands.

es.L: Así que, si {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estuviera en la tierra, ni siquiera sería sacerdote, puesto que hay quienes ofrecen los dones según la ley;
es.B: En la tierra ni siquiera sería sacerdote, porque ya hay hombres que presentan los dones que la ley exige.
es.R: Si Jesús estuviera en la tierra, no sería sacerdote en absoluto. Aquí ya hay sacerdotes que ofrecen los dones que manda la ley de Moisés.

fr.L: Si donc {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} était sur la terre, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne serait même pas prêtre, puisqu’il y a ceux qui offrent les dons selon [la] Loi ;
fr.B: Sur la terre, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne serait même pas prêtre, car il y a déjà des hommes qui présentent les dons prescrits par la Loi.
fr.R: Si Jésus était sur la terre, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne serait pas du tout prêtre. Il y a déjà ici des prêtres qui offrent les dons que demande la Loi de Moïse.

sw.L: Basi kama angekuwa duniani, asingekuwa hata kuhani, maana wapo wale wanaotoa zawadi kwa mujibu wa sheria;
sw.B: Kama angekuwa duniani, asingekuwa hata kuhani, kwa kuwa tayari wapo watu wanaoleta zawadi ambazo sheria inadai.
sw.R: Kama Yesu angekuwa duniani, asingekuwa kuhani kamwe. Tayari kuna makuhani hapa wanaotoa zawadi ambazo sheria ya Musa inaamuru.

vi.L: Vậy nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở dưới đất, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng không phải là thầy tế lễ, vì đã có những người dâng lễ vật theo luật pháp;
vi.B: Nếu ở dưới đất thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng không phải là thầy tế lễ, vì đã có những người dâng các lễ vật mà luật pháp đòi hỏi.
vi.R: Nếu Đức Giê-xu ở dưới đất thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hoàn toàn không phải là thầy tế lễ. Ở đây đã có những thầy tế lễ dâng các lễ vật mà luật pháp Môi-se truyền dạy.

ko.L: 만일 그분이 땅에 계셨다면 제사장도 되지 못하셨을 것입니다. 율법을 따라 예물을 드리는 사람들이 있기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 그분이 땅에 계신다면 제사장도 되지 못하셨을 것입니다. 율법이 정한 예물을 드리는 사람들이 이미 있기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 예수께서 땅에 계신다면, 그분은 제사장이 전혀 되지 못하실 것입니다. 이곳에는 모세의 율법이 명령하는 예물을 바치는 제사장들이 이미 있습니다.

pt.L: Se, pois, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estivesse na terra, nem sequer seria sacerdote, visto que há os que apresentam as ofertas segundo a Lei;
pt.B: Na terra, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nem sequer seria sacerdote, pois já há homens que apresentam as ofertas que a Lei exige.
pt.R: Se Jesus estivesse na terra, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não seria sacerdote de jeito nenhum. Aqui já existem sacerdotes que apresentam as ofertas que a Lei de Moisés manda.

am.L: በምድር ላይ ቢሆን ኖሮ፣ በሕግ መሠረት መባን የሚያቀርቡ ስላሉ፣ ካህን እንኳ ባልሆነ ነበር፤
am.B: በምድር ቢሆን ኖሮ ካህን እንኳ ባልሆነ ነበር፤ ሕጉ የሚጠይቀውን መባ የሚያቀርቡ ሰዎች አሉና።
am.R: ኢየሱስ በምድር ላይ ቢሆን ኖሮ ፈጽሞ ካህን ባልሆነ ነበር። የሙሴ ሕግ የሚያዝዘውን መባ የሚያቀርቡ ካህናት በዚህ አሉና።

decisions.choice: a condition contrary to fact: he is not on earth, and his priesthood is exercised in heaven
decisions.reason: The construction with ἂν states something unreal: if he were on earth (but he is not), he would not be a priest. His priesthood belongs to the heavenly sanctuary (8:1-2).

decisions.choice: on earth the law gives the priesthood to the line of Aaron, and Jesus was of Judah
decisions.reason: As 7:13-14 explained, the law appoints priests only from Levi through Aaron. On earth that place is already filled.

decisions.choice: there are those who offer: the present tense may show that the temple sacrifices were still going on when the author wrote, or may simply describe what the law prescribes
decisions.reason: Hebrews speaks of the priests' work in the present tense here and in 9:6-9 and 10:1-3, which may mean the temple in Jerusalem was still standing (it was destroyed in AD 70). But the author always describes the tabernacle of the Pentateuch, not the temple, so the present may describe what Scripture lays down.

decisions.choice: Jesus; the law of Moses
decisions.reason: Readable names Jesus and the law meant.

source.text: οἵτινες ὑποδείγματι καὶ σκιᾷ λατρεύουσιν τῶν ἐπουρανίων, καθὼς κεχρημάτισται Μωϋσῆς μέλλων ἐπιτελεῖν τὴν σκηνήν, Ὅρα γάρ, φησίν, ποιήσεις πάντα κατὰ τὸν τύπον τὸν δειχθέντα σοι ἐν τῷ ὄρει·

records.literal_gloss: who a copy and shadow serve of the heavenly [things], as has been divinely instructed Moses being about to complete the tent: See for, he says, you will make all things according to the pattern the [one] shown to you on the mountain;

en.L: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly [things], just as Moses was divinely instructed when he was about to complete the tent: for "See," {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says, "you shall make all things according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain";
en.B: The worship they offer is service in a copy and shadow of what is in heaven. So when Moses was about to set up the tabernacle, God instructed him: "Take care," {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said, "to make everything according to the pattern you were shown on the mountain."
en.R: These priests serve in a place that is only a copy and a shadow of what is in heaven. God warned Moses about this when Moses was about to build the sacred tent. God said, "Be careful to make everything just like the pattern I showed you on the mountain."

es.L: los cuales sirven a una copia y sombra de las [cosas] celestiales, tal como Moisés recibió instrucción divina cuando estaba a punto de acabar la tienda: porque «Mira», dice, «harás todas las cosas conforme al modelo que se te mostró en el monte»;
es.B: El culto que ofrecen es un servicio en una copia y sombra de lo que hay en el cielo. Por eso, cuando Moisés estaba a punto de levantar el tabernáculo, Dios le dio instrucciones: «Ten cuidado», dijo, «de hacerlo todo según el modelo que se te mostró en el monte».
es.R: Estos sacerdotes sirven en un lugar que es solo una copia y una sombra de lo que hay en el cielo. Dios advirtió de esto a Moisés cuando Moisés estaba a punto de construir la tienda sagrada. Dios dijo: «Ten cuidado de hacerlo todo igual que el modelo que te mostré en el monte».

fr.L: qui servent une copie et une ombre des [réalités] célestes, comme Moïse a été divinement averti lorsqu’il allait achever la tente : car « Vois », dit-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}, « tu feras toutes choses selon le modèle qui t’a été montré sur la montagne » ;
fr.B: Le culte qu’ils rendent est un service dans une copie et une ombre de ce qui est dans le ciel. C’est pourquoi, lorsque Moïse allait dresser le tabernacle, Dieu lui donna cette instruction : « Prends garde », dit-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}, « à tout faire selon le modèle qui t’a été montré sur la montagne. »
fr.R: Ces prêtres servent dans un lieu qui n’est qu’une copie et une ombre de ce qui est dans le ciel. Dieu en a averti Moïse quand celui-ci allait construire la tente sacrée. Dieu lui a dit : « Fais bien attention à tout faire exactement comme le modèle que je t’ai montré sur la montagne. »

sw.L: ambao wanatumikia nakala na kivuli cha [mambo] ya mbinguni, kama vile Musa alivyopewa agizo [na Mungu] alipokuwa karibu kumaliza kusimika hema; kwa maana "Angalia," asema, "utafanya vitu vyote kufuatana na kielelezo ulichoonyeshwa mlimani";
sw.B: Ibada wanayotoa ni huduma katika nakala na kivuli cha yaliyo mbinguni. Ndiyo sababu Musa alipokuwa karibu kusimika hema, Mungu alimwagiza: "Hakikisha," alisema, "unafanya kila kitu kufuatana na kielelezo ulichoonyeshwa mlimani."
sw.R: Makuhani hao wanahudumu katika mahali ambapo ni nakala tu na kivuli cha yaliyo mbinguni. Mungu alimwonya Musa juu ya jambo hili wakati Musa alipokuwa karibu kujenga hema takatifu. Mungu alisema, "Uwe mwangalifu kufanya kila kitu sawasawa na kielelezo nilichokuonyesha mlimani."

vi.L: là những người phục vụ một bản sao và bóng của những điều trên trời, như Môi-se đã được Đức Chúa Trời chỉ dạy khi ông sắp dựng xong lều: vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán: "Hãy xem, con sẽ làm mọi thứ theo kiểu mẫu đã chỉ cho con trên núi";
vi.B: Sự thờ phượng họ dâng là sự phục vụ trong một bản sao và cái bóng của những gì ở trên trời. Vì vậy khi Môi-se sắp dựng đền tạm, Đức Chúa Trời đã chỉ dạy ông: {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán: "Hãy cẩn thận làm mọi thứ theo đúng kiểu mẫu đã chỉ cho con trên núi."
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ ấy phục vụ ở một nơi chỉ là bản sao và cái bóng của những gì ở trên trời. Đức Chúa Trời đã căn dặn Môi-se về điều này khi Môi-se sắp làm lều thánh. Đức Chúa Trời phán: "Hãy cẩn thận làm mọi thứ đúng theo kiểu mẫu Ta đã chỉ cho con trên núi."

ko.L: 그들은 하늘에 있는 것들의 모형과 그림자를 섬깁니다. 모세가 장막을 세우려고 할 때에 지시를 받은 것과 같습니다. 그분이 이르시기를 "보라, 산에서 너에게 보여 준 본을 따라 모든 것을 만들어라" 하셨습니다.
ko.B: 그들이 드리는 예배는 하늘에 있는 것의 모형과 그림자에서 섬기는 일입니다. 그래서 모세가 성막을 세우려고 할 때, 하나님께서 그에게 지시하셨습니다. "너는 산에서 네게 보여 준 본을 따라 모든 것을 만들도록 주의하여라" 하고 말씀하셨습니다.
ko.R: 이 제사장들이 섬기는 곳은 하늘에 있는 것을 본뜬 것이요 그 그림자일 뿐입니다. 모세가 거룩한 장막을 지으려고 할 때, 하나님께서 그에게 이 일에 대하여 단단히 이르셨습니다. 하나님께서는 "내가 산에서 너에게 보여 준 본과 똑같이 모든 것을 만들도록 조심하여라" 하고 말씀하셨습니다.

pt.L: os quais servem a uma cópia e sombra das [coisas] celestiais, assim como Moisés foi divinamente instruído quando estava para completar a tenda: pois "Vê", diz {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, "farás todas as coisas conforme o modelo que te foi mostrado no monte";
pt.B: O culto que eles prestam é serviço numa cópia e sombra do que está no céu. Assim, quando Moisés estava para erguer o tabernáculo, Deus o instruiu: "Toma cuidado", disse {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, "de fazer tudo conforme o modelo que te foi mostrado no monte."
pt.R: Esses sacerdotes servem num lugar que é só uma cópia e uma sombra do que está no céu. Deus avisou Moisés sobre isso quando Moisés estava para construir a tenda sagrada. Deus disse: "Toma cuidado para fazer tudo exatamente como o modelo que eu te mostrei no monte."

am.L: እነርሱም የሰማያዊው ነገር ቅጂና ጥላ በሆነው ያገለግላሉ፤ ሙሴ ድንኳኑን ሊያጠናቅቅ ሲል ከእግዚአብሔር እንደ ተነገረው፤ «ተመልከት» ይላልና፣ «በተራራው ላይ በታየህ ንድፍ መሠረት ሁሉን ታደርጋለህ»፤
am.B: የሚያቀርቡትም አምልኮ በሰማይ ያለው ነገር ቅጂና ጥላ በሆነው ስፍራ የሚደረግ አገልግሎት ነው። ስለዚህ ሙሴ ድንኳኑን ሊተክል ሲል እግዚአብሔር አዘዘው፤ «ተጠንቀቅ» አለው፤ «በተራራው ላይ በታየህ ንድፍ መሠረት ሁሉን አድርግ።»
am.R: እነዚህ ካህናት የሚያገለግሉት በሰማይ ያለው ነገር ቅጂና ጥላ ብቻ በሆነ ስፍራ ነው። ሙሴ የተቀደሰውን ድንኳን ሊሠራ ሲል እግዚአብሔር ስለዚህ አስጠነቀቀው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አለው፦ «በተራራው ላይ ባሳየሁህ ንድፍ መሠረት ሁሉን እንድትሠራ ተጠንቀቅ።»

decisions.choice: Exodus 25:40
decisions.reason: God's words to Moses on Mount Sinai in Exodus 25:40 (compare 25:9, 26:30, 27:8). Hebrews includes "all things" (πάντα), which the Hebrew of 25:40 does not have; Exodus 25:9 says the same of the whole tabernacle and its furnishings, "according to all that I show you". Reviewers should check the wording of the Greek Exodus.

decisions.choice: a copy and shadow: an outline or sketch, and a shadow cast by a real object
decisions.reason: ὑποδείγματι is a copy or outline drawn from an original; σκιᾷ is the shadow a real thing casts. Both say the earthly sanctuary was real but secondary, pointing beyond itself to the heavenly one (9:23-24; 10:1).

decisions.choice: pattern: the model or design shown to Moses
decisions.reason: τύπον is the model from which a copy is made. Exodus says God showed Moses the pattern of the tabernacle; the author takes it as a pattern of the heavenly sanctuary. He does not say how Moses saw it.

decisions.choice: divinely instructed: given an oracle or command by God
decisions.reason: κεχρημάτισται is used of God giving a message or warning (11:7; 12:25; Matthew 2:12).

decisions.choice: God instructed him; God warned Moses ... God said
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God as the one who spoke.

decisions.choice: the pattern I showed you
decisions.reason: Readable lets God speak in the active voice.

decisions.choice: tent (Literal); tabernacle (Balanced); sacred tent (Readable)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for σκηνή in Hebrews.

decisions.choice: nakala (copy); kielelezo (pattern)
decisions.reason: "Mfano" could serve for both words but also means an example or a parable. "Nakala" is a copy made from an original, and "kielelezo" the model a copy is made from, which keeps the two sides apart as the meaning decisions describe.

decisions.choice: alivyopewa agizo [na Mungu]
decisions.reason: The Greek verb itself says the instruction came from God; Swahili needs the agent named, so Literal brackets it.

decisions.choice: dit-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}
decisions.reason: The inserted "he says" refers to God, so the pronoun of the French incise "dit-il" takes the deity_pronoun span, as the English "he" does. Balanced tells Moses's instruction in the passé simple ("donna", "dit"), as a small narrative inside the argument.

decisions.choice: "bản sao và bóng" (L), "bản sao và cái bóng" (B, R); "kiểu mẫu"; "con" for Moses in God's words
decisions.reason: A copy and a shadow cast by a real object (m2), and the pattern shown to Moses (m3). God speaks to Moses as "con", as he speaks to Abraham (6:14); "ngươi" is kept for God's words to the people in Psalm 95.

decisions.choice: "모형" (L, B), "본뜬 것" (R) for the copy; "그림자" for the shadow; "본" for the pattern
decisions.reason: The copy is an outline or sketch, and the shadow is cast by a real object (meaning decision); the pattern is the model shown to Moses. "본" is the plain word for a model to copy; "식양" belongs to the older Bibles.

decisions.choice: God says "tu" to Moses: "Vê", "farás", "te" (L); "Toma cuidado", "te" (B, R)
decisions.reason: God speaking to a person uses "tu" at every level, as the Old Testament does throughout (style section 4); Readable keeps it too, as with the commandments.

decisions.choice: ቅጂ (copy); ንድፍ (pattern)
decisions.reason: The argument sets the earthly copy against the heavenly pattern shown to Moses; ቅጂ and ንድፍ keep the two words apart, where ምሳሌ would blur them.

source.text: νυνὶ δὲ διαφορωτέρας τέτυχεν λειτουργίας, ὅσῳ καὶ κρείττονός ἐστιν διαθήκης μεσίτης, ἥτις ἐπὶ κρείττοσιν ἐπαγγελίαις νενομοθέτηται.

records.literal_gloss: Now however a more excellent he has obtained ministry, by as much also of a better he is covenant mediator, which upon better promises has been enacted.

en.L: But now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is also mediator of a better covenant, which has been enacted on better promises.
en.B: As it is, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has been given a far higher ministry, in keeping with the better covenant of which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is mediator, a covenant set in law on better promises.
en.R: But the priestly work Jesus has been given is far greater than theirs. In the same way, the covenant {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brings between God and people is better. It was made on the basis of better promises.

es.L: Pero ahora {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha obtenido un ministerio más excelente, en la medida en que es también mediador de un pacto mejor, que ha sido promulgado sobre promesas mejores.
es.B: Pero ahora se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} ha dado un ministerio muy superior, a la medida del pacto mejor del cual es mediador, un pacto establecido por ley sobre promesas mejores.
es.R: Pero la obra sacerdotal que Jesús ha recibido es mucho mayor que la de ellos. De la misma manera, el pacto que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} establece entre Dios y las personas es mejor. Fue hecho sobre la base de promesas mejores.

fr.L: Mais maintenant {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a obtenu un ministère d’autant plus excellent qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est aussi médiateur d’une meilleure alliance, qui a été établie sur de meilleures promesses.
fr.B: En réalité, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a reçu un ministère bien supérieur, à la mesure de l’alliance meilleure dont {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est le médiateur, une alliance instituée, avec force de loi, sur de meilleures promesses.
fr.R: Mais le travail de prêtre que Jésus a reçu est bien plus grand que le leur. De la même façon, l’alliance qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} établit entre Dieu et les humains est meilleure. Elle a été faite sur la base de meilleures promesses.

sw.L: Lakini sasa amepokea huduma yenye ubora mkuu zaidi, kwa kadiri {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} pia alivyo mpatanishi wa agano bora zaidi, ambalo limewekwa kisheria juu ya ahadi bora zaidi.
sw.B: Kama mambo yalivyo, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} amepewa huduma iliyo kuu zaidi sana, inayolingana na agano bora zaidi ambalo {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mpatanishi wake, agano lililowekwa kisheria juu ya ahadi bora zaidi.
sw.R: Lakini kazi ya kikuhani ambayo Yesu amepewa ni kubwa zaidi sana kuliko yao. Vivyo hivyo, agano analoleta kati ya Mungu na watu ni bora zaidi. Liliwekwa kwa msingi wa ahadi bora zaidi.

vi.L: Nhưng nay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nhận được một chức vụ cao quý hơn, cũng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng trung gian của một giao ước tốt hơn, là giao ước đã được thiết lập trên những lời hứa tốt hơn.
vi.B: Thật vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã được giao một chức vụ cao trọng hơn nhiều, tương xứng với giao ước tốt hơn mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng trung gian, là giao ước đã được lập thành luật dựa trên những lời hứa tốt hơn.
vi.R: Nhưng công việc tế lễ mà Đức Giê-xu được giao lớn hơn công việc của họ rất nhiều. Cũng vậy, giao ước mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đem đến giữa Đức Chúa Trời và loài người tốt hơn. Giao ước ấy được lập dựa trên những lời hứa tốt hơn.

ko.L: 그러나 이제 그분은 더 나은 언약의 중개자이신 만큼, 그만큼 더 뛰어난 직무를 얻으셨습니다. 그 언약은 더 나은 약속들 위에 법으로 세워졌습니다.
ko.B: 그러나 이제 그분은 훨씬 더 높은 직무를 받으셨습니다. 그분이 중개하시는 언약이 더 나은 것과 같습니다. 그 언약은 더 나은 약속들을 바탕으로 세워졌습니다.
ko.R: 그러나 예수께서 맡으신 제사장의 일은 그들의 일보다 훨씬 더 큽니다. 마찬가지로 그분이 하나님과 사람들 사이에 세우시는 언약도 더 낫습니다. 그 언약은 더 나은 약속들을 바탕으로 세워졌습니다.

pt.L: Mas agora {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} obteve um ministério mais excelente, tanto quanto é também mediador de uma aliança melhor, que foi promulgada sobre promessas melhores.
pt.B: Na realidade, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} recebeu um ministério muito superior, à altura da aliança melhor da qual é mediador, uma aliança instituída por lei com base em promessas melhores.
pt.R: Mas o trabalho de sacerdote que Jesus recebeu é muito maior que o deles. Do mesmo modo, a aliança que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} traz entre Deus e as pessoas é melhor. Ela foi feita com base em promessas melhores.

am.L: አሁን ግን በተሻሉ የተስፋ ቃሎች ላይ በሕግ የጸና የተሻለ ኪዳን መካከለኛ እንደ ሆነ መጠን፣ እጅግ የሚበልጥ አገልግሎት አግኝቷል።
am.B: አሁን ግን እጅግ የላቀ አገልግሎት ተሰጥቶታል፤ ይህም መካከለኛ ከሆነለት ከተሻለው ኪዳን ጋር የሚመጣጠን ነው፤ ይህም ኪዳን በተሻሉ የተስፋ ቃሎች ላይ በሕግ የጸና ነው።
am.R: ኢየሱስ የተሰጠው የክህነት ሥራ ግን ከእነርሱ እጅግ የበለጠ ነው። እንዲሁም በእግዚአብሔርና በሰዎች መካከል የሚያመጣው ኪዳን የተሻለ ነው። ይህም ኪዳን የተመሠረተው በተሻሉ የተስፋ ቃሎች ላይ ነው።

decisions.choice: now: as things are, in fact
decisions.reason: νυνὶ here is logical rather than temporal: in contrast to the unreal "if he were on earth" (verse 4), this is how things actually are.

decisions.choice: mediator: one who stands between two parties to establish a covenant
decisions.reason: μεσίτης is a go-between who brings parties together and secures their agreement. Moses was the mediator of the covenant at Sinai (Galatians 3:19); Jesus is the mediator of the new one (9:15; 12:24).

decisions.choice: enacted: given the force of law
decisions.reason: νενομοθέτηται is the verb used of the people "receiving the law" in 7:11. The new covenant also has legal standing, but it rests on better promises, which verses 10-12 spell out.

decisions.choice: by as much as: the excellence of his ministry matches the excellence of the covenant he mediates
decisions.reason: The comparison ὅσῳ ties the two together, as 7:20-22 did for the oath and the covenant.

decisions.choice: the priestly work Jesus has been given
decisions.reason: λειτουργίας is priestly service, so Readable says "priestly work" and names Jesus.

decisions.choice: promulgado (Literal); establecido por ley (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for giving a law (meaning decision m3); these keep that legal sense.

decisions.choice: mpatanishi
decisions.reason: "Mpatanishi" is one who brings two parties to agreement, the go-between of the meaning decision; "mjumbe" is only a messenger. Readable says what he does, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Đấng trung gian" (L, B) for the mediator, also 9:15 and 12:24; Readable says what he does
decisions.reason: The mediator stands between two parties to establish a covenant (m2). Here he is Christ, so "Đấng", as in the Vietnamese 1 Timothy (2:5), against "người trung gian" for Moses in Galatians 3:19.

decisions.choice: "중개자" (L), "중개하시다" (B), "하나님과 사람들 사이에 세우시다" (R) for the mediator, here and in 9:15 and 12:24
decisions.reason: A mediator stands between two parties to establish a covenant (meaning decision). "중개자" is the word of the Korean 1 Timothy 2:5; "중보자" is the older church word.

decisions.choice: promulgada (L); instituída por lei (B)
decisions.reason: "Promulgar" is the Portuguese verb for giving a law its force, which is the sense of m3; Balanced spells it out as "instituída por lei", as the English "set in law".

decisions.choice: መካከለኛ (mediator)
decisions.reason: The mediator stands between two parties to establish a covenant (meaning decision m2); መካከለኛ says that, and is the church's word in 9:15 and 12:24 as well.

source.text: Εἰ γὰρ ἡ πρώτη ἐκείνη ἦν ἄμεμπτος, οὐκ ἂν δευτέρας ἐζητεῖτο τόπος·

records.literal_gloss: If for the first that had been faultless, not would of a second have been sought place;

en.L: For if that first [covenant] had been faultless, place for a second would not have been sought.
en.B: Had that first covenant been free of fault, no room would have been sought for a second one.
en.R: If the first covenant had been without fault, there would have been no reason to look for a second one.

es.L: Porque si aquel primer [pacto] hubiera sido intachable, no se habría buscado lugar para un segundo.
es.B: Si aquel primer pacto hubiera estado libre de falta, no se habría buscado lugar para un segundo.
es.R: Si el primer pacto no hubiera tenido ningún defecto, no habría habido razón para buscar un segundo.

fr.L: Car si cette première [alliance] avait été sans défaut, on n’aurait pas cherché de place pour une seconde.
fr.B: Si cette première alliance avait été sans faute, on n’aurait pas cherché à faire place à une seconde.
fr.R: Si la première alliance avait été sans défaut, il n’y aurait eu aucune raison d’en chercher une deuxième.

sw.L: Kwa maana kama lile [agano] la kwanza lisingekuwa na lawama, nafasi ya la pili isingetafutwa.
sw.B: Kama agano lile la kwanza lingekuwa bila lawama, hakuna nafasi ambayo ingetafutwa kwa ajili ya agano la pili.
sw.R: Kama agano la kwanza lisingekuwa na kasoro, kusingekuwa na sababu ya kutafuta agano la pili.

vi.L: Vì nếu giao ước thứ nhất ấy không có khuyết điểm, thì đã không tìm chỗ cho một giao ước thứ hai.
vi.B: Nếu giao ước thứ nhất không có khuyết điểm, thì đã chẳng cần tìm chỗ cho một giao ước thứ hai.
vi.R: Nếu giao ước thứ nhất không có khuyết điểm, thì đã không có lý do gì để tìm một giao ước thứ hai.

ko.L: 만일 저 첫 [언약]에 흠이 없었다면, 둘째 [언약]의 자리를 찾지 않았을 것입니다.
ko.B: 그 첫 언약에 흠이 없었다면, 둘째 언약이 들어설 자리를 찾을 필요가 없었을 것입니다.
ko.R: 첫 언약에 잘못된 점이 없었다면, 둘째 언약을 찾을 까닭이 없었을 것입니다.

pt.L: Pois, se aquela primeira [aliança] tivesse sido sem defeito, não se teria buscado lugar para uma segunda.
pt.B: Se aquela primeira aliança tivesse sido irrepreensível, não se teria procurado lugar para uma segunda.
pt.R: Se a primeira aliança não tivesse nenhum defeito, não haveria motivo para procurar uma segunda.

am.L: ያ የመጀመሪያው [ኪዳን] ነቀፋ የሌለበት ቢሆን ኖሮ ለሁለተኛው ስፍራ ባልተፈለገ ነበርና።
am.B: ያ የመጀመሪያው ኪዳን ከነቀፋ ነጻ ቢሆን ኖሮ፣ ለሁለተኛው ስፍራ ባልተፈለገ ነበር።
am.R: የመጀመሪያው ኪዳን ምንም ጉድለት ባይኖርበት ኖሮ፣ ሁለተኛውን መፈለግ ባላስፈለገ ነበር።

decisions.choice: the first: the first covenant
decisions.reason: The word "covenant" is understood from verse 6. The first covenant is the one made at Sinai (8:9).

decisions.choice: faultless: the first covenant could not make the people keep it, and so it was not without fault
decisions.reason: Verse 8 places the blame on the people ("finding fault with them"). The fault of the first covenant was that it could not change the people's hearts; the new covenant writes the law on them (verse 10).

decisions.choice: bila lawama; lisingekuwa na lawama
decisions.reason: The Greek word for "faultless" shares its root with "finding fault" in verse 8; "lawama" (blame) here and "akiwalaumu" there keep the link in Swahili. Readable says "kasoro" (defect), a plainer word.

source.text: μεμφόμενος γὰρ αὐτοὺς λέγει· Ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται, λέγει κύριος, καὶ συντελέσω ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον Ἰούδα διαθήκην καινήν, οὐ κατὰ τὴν διαθήκην ἣν ἐποίησα τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἐπιλαβομένου μου τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῶν ἐξαγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου, ὅτι αὐτοὶ οὐκ ἐνέμειναν ἐν τῇ διαθήκῃ μου, κἀγὼ ἠμέλησα αὐτῶν, λέγει κύριος.

records.literal_gloss: Finding fault for with them he says: Look, days are coming, says Lord, and I will accomplish upon the house of Israel and upon the house of Judah a covenant new, \v 9 not according to the covenant which I made with the fathers of them in day of taking hold me of the hand of them to lead out them out of land of Egypt, because they not continued in the covenant of me, and I disregarded them, says Lord.

en.L: For finding fault with them, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says, "Look, days are coming, says [the] Lord, and I will bring to completion with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah a new covenant, \v 9 not like the covenant that I made with their fathers on [the] day when I took hold of their hand to lead them out of [the] land of Egypt; because they did not continue in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant, and I disregarded them, says [the] Lord."
en.B: For God finds fault with them when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says, "A time is coming, says the Lord, when I will bring about a new covenant with the house of Israel and the house of Judah. \v 9 It will differ from the covenant I made with their {{gender:ancestors|fathers}} on the day I took hold of their hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt. They did not hold to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant, so I paid them no more attention, says the Lord."
en.R: But God blamed the people. He said, "A time is coming, says the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with Israel and with Judah. \v 9 It will not be like the covenant I made with their {{gender:ancestors|fathers}}. I made that covenant when I led them out of Egypt, holding them by the hand. But they did not keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant, so I left them to themselves, says the Lord."

es.L: Porque, reprochándoles, dice: «Mira, vienen días, dice [el] Señor, y llevaré a término con la casa de Israel y con la casa de Judá un pacto nuevo, \v 9 no como el pacto que hice con sus padres en [el] día en que tomé su mano para sacarlos de [la] tierra de Egipto; porque ellos no permanecieron en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto, y yo me desentendí de ellos, dice [el] Señor».
es.B: Porque Dios les reprocha su falta cuando dice: «Viene un tiempo, dice el Señor, en que haré realidad un pacto nuevo con la casa de Israel y con la casa de Judá. \v 9 Será distinto del pacto que hice con sus {{gender:antepasados|padres}} el día en que los tomé de la mano para sacarlos de la tierra de Egipto. Ellos no se mantuvieron fieles a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto, y por eso dejé de ocuparme de ellos, dice el Señor».
es.R: Pero Dios culpó al pueblo. Dijo: «Viene un tiempo, dice el Señor, en que haré un pacto nuevo con Israel y con Judá. \v 9 No será como el pacto que hice con sus {{gender:antepasados|padres}}. Hice ese pacto cuando los saqué de Egipto, llevándolos de la mano. Pero ellos no cumplieron {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto, así que los dejé a su suerte, dice el Señor».

fr.L: Car, leur faisant des reproches, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « Voici, des jours viennent, dit [le] Seigneur, et j’accomplirai avec la maison d’Israël et avec la maison de Juda une alliance nouvelle, \v 9 non comme l’alliance que j’ai faite avec leurs pères au jour où j’ai pris leur main pour les faire sortir du pays d’Égypte ; parce qu’ils ne sont pas demeurés dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance, et je les ai délaissés, dit [le] Seigneur. »
fr.B: Car Dieu leur fait des reproches quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit : « Un temps vient, dit le Seigneur, où j’établirai une alliance nouvelle avec la maison d’Israël et la maison de Juda. \v 9 Elle sera différente de l’alliance que j’ai faite avec leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} le jour où je les ai pris par la main pour les faire sortir du pays d’Égypte. Ils ne sont pas restés fidèles à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance, et je ne me suis plus occupé d’eux, dit le Seigneur. »
fr.R: Mais Dieu a fait des reproches au peuple. Il a dit : « Un temps vient, dit le Seigneur, où je ferai une alliance nouvelle avec Israël et avec Juda. \v 9 Elle ne sera pas comme l’alliance que j’ai faite avec leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}. J’ai fait cette alliance quand je les ai fait sortir d’Égypte en les tenant par la main. Mais ils n’ont pas gardé {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance, alors je les ai laissés à eux-mêmes, dit le Seigneur. »

sw.L: Kwa maana, akiwalaumu, anasema, "Tazama, siku zinakuja, anasema Bwana, nami nitahitimisha pamoja na nyumba ya Israeli na nyumba ya Yuda agano jipya, \v 9 lisilo kama agano nililofanya pamoja na mababa zao siku nilipowashika mkono wao ili kuwaongoza kutoka nchi ya Misri; kwa sababu wao hawakudumu katika agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, nami nikawapuuza, anasema Bwana."
sw.B: Kwa maana Mungu anawalaumu anaposema, "Wakati unakuja, anasema Bwana, ambapo nitaanzisha agano jipya na nyumba ya Israeli na nyumba ya Yuda. \v 9 Litatofautiana na agano nililofanya na mababu zao siku ile nilipowashika mkono kuwatoa katika nchi ya Misri. Hawakushikamana na agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, kwa hiyo nikaacha kuwashughulikia, anasema Bwana."
sw.R: Lakini Mungu aliwalaumu watu. Alisema, "Wakati unakuja, anasema Bwana, nitakapofanya agano jipya na Israeli na Yuda. \v 9 Agano hilo litakuwa tofauti na lile nililofanya na mababu zao. Nilifanya agano lile nilipowatoa Misri, nikiwashika mkono. Lakini hawakulishika agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, kwa hiyo niliwaacha peke yao, anasema Bwana."

vi.L: Vì khi trách họ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán: "Này, những ngày đang đến, Chúa phán, khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ hoàn thành với nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên và với nhà Giu-đa một giao ước mới, \v 9 không giống như giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lập với tổ phụ họ trong ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nắm tay họ để dẫn họ ra khỏi đất Ai Cập; vì họ đã không ở trong giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã không đoái đến họ nữa, Chúa phán."
vi.B: Vì Đức Chúa Trời trách họ khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán: "Chúa phán: Sẽ đến lúc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lập một giao ước mới với nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên và nhà Giu-đa. \v 9 Giao ước ấy sẽ không giống như giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lập với tổ tiên họ trong ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nắm tay họ dẫn ra khỏi đất Ai Cập. Họ đã không giữ giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không còn đoái đến họ nữa, Chúa phán vậy."
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời đã trách dân chúng. Ngài phán: "Chúa phán: Sẽ đến lúc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lập một giao ước mới với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên và dân Giu-đa. \v 9 Giao ước ấy sẽ không giống như giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lập với tổ tiên họ. Ta đã lập giao ước ấy khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nắm tay dẫn họ ra khỏi Ai Cập. Nhưng họ đã không giữ giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} để mặc họ, Chúa phán vậy."

ko.L: 그분은 그들을 나무라시며 말씀하십니다. "보라, 날들이 온다, 주님께서 말씀하신다. 내가 이스라엘 집과 유다 집과 더불어 새 언약을 이룰 것이다. \v 9 그것은 내가 그들의 조상들의 손을 잡고 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 내던 날에 그들과 맺은 언약과 같지 않을 것이다. 그들이 내 언약 안에 머물지 않았으므로, 나도 그들을 돌보지 않았다, 주님께서 말씀하신다."
ko.B: 하나님께서는 그들을 나무라시며 이렇게 말씀하십니다. "주님께서 말씀하신다. 때가 오고 있다. 그때에 내가 이스라엘 집과 유다 집과 새 언약을 세울 것이다. \v 9 그 언약은 내가 그들의 조상들의 손을 잡고 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 내던 날에 그들과 맺은 언약과 다를 것이다. 그들은 내 언약을 지키지 않았다. 그래서 나도 그들을 더 이상 돌보지 않았다. 주님께서 말씀하신다."
ko.R: 그러나 하나님께서는 그 백성을 나무라셨습니다. 하나님께서 말씀하셨습니다. "주님께서 말씀하신다. 때가 오고 있다. 그때에 내가 이스라엘과 유다와 새 언약을 맺을 것이다. \v 9 그 언약은 내가 그들의 조상들과 맺은 언약과 같지 않을 것이다. 나는 그들의 손을 잡고 이집트에서 이끌어 낼 때 그 언약을 맺었다. 그러나 그들은 내 언약을 지키지 않았다. 그래서 나는 그들을 그대로 내버려 두었다. 주님께서 말씀하신다."

pt.L: Pois, censurando-os, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} diz: "Eis que vêm dias, diz [o] Senhor, e levarei a termo com a casa de Israel e com a casa de Judá uma aliança nova, \v 9 não como a aliança que fiz com os pais deles no dia em que os tomei pela mão para tirá-los da terra do Egito; porque eles não permaneceram na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança, e eu os desconsiderei, diz [o] Senhor."
pt.B: Pois Deus os censura quando diz: "Vem um tempo, diz o Senhor, em que estabelecerei uma nova aliança com a casa de Israel e com a casa de Judá. \v 9 Ela será diferente da aliança que fiz com {{gender:os antepassados|os pais}} deles no dia em que os tomei pela mão para tirá-los da terra do Egito. Eles não se mantiveram fiéis à {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança, e por isso deixei de me ocupar deles, diz o Senhor."
pt.R: Mas Deus culpou o povo. Ele disse: "Vem um tempo, diz o Senhor, em que vou fazer uma nova aliança com Israel e com Judá. \v 9 Ela não vai ser como a aliança que fiz com {{gender:os antepassados|os pais}} deles. Eu fiz aquela aliança quando tirei o povo do Egito, levando-o pela mão. Mas eles não cumpriram a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança, e por isso eu os deixei entregues a si mesmos, diz o Senhor."

am.L: እነርሱን እየነቀፈ እንዲህ ይላልና፦ «እነሆ፣ ቀኖች ይመጣሉ፣ ይላል ጌታ፣ ከእስራኤል ቤትና ከይሁዳ ቤት ጋር አዲስ ኪዳን እፈጽማለሁ፤ \v 9 ከግብፅ ምድር አወጣቸው ዘንድ እጃቸውን በያዝኩበት ቀን ከአባቶቻቸው ጋር እንዳደረግኩት ኪዳን አይደለም፤ እነርሱ በኪዳኔ ጸንተው አልኖሩምና፤ እኔም ቸል አልኳቸው፣ ይላል ጌታ።»
am.B: እግዚአብሔር እነርሱን ሲነቅፍ እንዲህ ይላልና፦ «ከእስራኤል ቤትና ከይሁዳ ቤት ጋር አዲስ ኪዳን የምመሠርትበት ጊዜ ይመጣል፣ ይላል ጌታ። \v 9 ከግብፅ ምድር ላወጣቸው እጃቸውን በያዝኩበት ቀን {{gender:ከቅድመ አያቶቻቸው|ከአባቶቻቸው}} ጋር ካደረግኩት ኪዳን የተለየ ይሆናል። እነርሱ ኪዳኔን አልጠበቁም፤ ስለዚህ ከዚያ ወዲያ ቸል አልኳቸው፣ ይላል ጌታ።»
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ግን ሕዝቡን ወቀሰ። እንዲህም አለ፦ «ከእስራኤልና ከይሁዳ ጋር አዲስ ኪዳን የማደርግበት ጊዜ ይመጣል፣ ይላል ጌታ። \v 9 {{gender:ከቅድመ አያቶቻቸው|ከአባቶቻቸው}} ጋር ያደረግኩትን ኪዳን አይመስልም። ያንን ኪዳን ያደረግኩት እጃቸውን ይዤ ከግብፅ ባወጣኋቸው ጊዜ ነው። እነርሱ ግን ኪዳኔን አልጠበቁም፤ ስለዚህ ለራሳቸው ተውኳቸው፣ ይላል ጌታ።»

decisions.choice: Jeremiah 31:31-32 (38:31-32 Greek)
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 31:31-34 (38:31-34 Greek) is the longest Old Testament quotation in the New Testament. The author quotes it in its Greek form and comes back to it in 10:16-17. Where Hebrews has κύριος ("Lord"), the Hebrew of Jeremiah has the divine name, YHWH. Hebrews' wording differs a little from the usual Greek text of Jeremiah: it has συντελέσω ("I will accomplish") and ἐποίησα ("I made") where the Greek Jeremiah has the verb used in verse 10 (διατίθεμαι); reviewers should check this against the Greek text.

decisions.choice: with them: God finds fault with the people
alternatives: finding fault, he says to them
decisions.reason: SBLGNT reads αὐτοὺς (accusative), "finding fault with them". Many manuscripts read the dative, which can be taken "he says to them" and leave open whether the fault is found with the covenant or the people. The accusative is well attested in early manuscripts; reviewers must check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: I disregarded them: I ceased to care for them; the Hebrew reads "although I was a husband to them"
decisions.reason: The Greek of Jeremiah, which Hebrews quotes, has ἠμέλησα ("I neglected, disregarded"). The Hebrew of Jeremiah 31:32 reads differently: "my covenant, which they broke, although I was a husband (or master) to them". The Greek translators read or understood the Hebrew verb differently. The author quotes the Greek, which fits his point: the people did not keep the covenant, and it failed to hold them.

decisions.choice: the house of Israel and the house of Judah: the whole people, once divided into two kingdoms
decisions.reason: After Solomon the people split into the northern kingdom (Israel) and the southern (Judah). The promise is to the whole people, reunited under one covenant (Ezekiel 37:15-28).

decisions.choice: the covenant made with the fathers: the covenant at Sinai after the exodus from Egypt
decisions.reason: God led Israel out of Egypt and made the covenant with them at Mount Sinai (Exodus 19-24). The picture of taking them by the hand is of a parent leading a child (Hosea 11:1-4).

decisions.choice: Look (Literal); left untranslated (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Ἰδοὺ calls for attention. "Behold" is no longer current English; Literal says "Look", and Balanced and Readable carry the sense with "A time is coming".

decisions.choice: bring to completion (Literal); bring about (Balanced); make (Readable)
decisions.reason: συντελέσω means to accomplish or carry out. With a covenant it means to bring it into being; Readable uses the plainest verb.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God as the speaker of the prophecy.

decisions.choice: I left them to themselves
decisions.reason: A plain way to say that God stopped caring for a people who would not keep his covenant.

decisions.choice: sus padres (Literal); sus {{gender:antepasados|padres}} (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As through Hebrews: the generation at the exodus, men and women (meaning decision m5). Literal keeps the Greek word; Balanced and Readable let the reader choose the traditional "padres".

decisions.choice: me desentendí de ellos (Literal); dejé de ocuparme de ellos (Balanced); los dejé a su suerte (Readable)
decisions.reason: The sense is ceasing to care for them (meaning decision m3), not despising them; each level says that in its own register, as the English does.

decisions.choice: nitahitimisha
decisions.reason: "Kuhitimisha" is to conclude or carry through, as one concludes an agreement. "Kukamilisha" is kept in Hebrews for the "perfect" words, and "kutimiza" would suggest fulfilling an earlier promise.

decisions.choice: mababa (Literal); mababu (Balanced, Readable); no setting
decisions.reason: As the book-wide choice: Literal keeps "fathers", Balanced and Readable say "ancestors". "Mababu" has no traditional alternative to offer, so the English gender span has no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: leurs pères (Literal); leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The French ruling for Hebrews, as in English: Literal keeps the word of the text, and Balanced and Readable give the inclusive "ancêtres" with the traditional "pères" as the alternative.

decisions.choice: "Ta" for God, "Chúa phán" for "says the Lord"; "giao ước mới"; "không đoái đến họ nữa" (L, B), "để mặc họ" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of Jeremiah 31 are God's own, so God says "Ta", and "says the Lord" keeps the plain "Chúa", since the Greek has kyrios. "Giao ước mới" is the phrase of the Vietnamese Luke (22:20). "Đoái đến" is to turn one's care toward someone; its negation says the Greek "I disregarded them" (m3).

decisions.choice: "tổ phụ họ" (L); "tổ tiên họ" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in 1:1 and 3:9: "tổ tiên" includes women and men, so the English setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah 31 in 해라체, God speaking with "나"; "주님께서 말씀하신다" for "says the Lord", with no divine_name span; "새 언약", as in the Korean Luke 22:20; "보라" (L), left out (B, R)
decisions.reason: God's words take the plain style used for him through the letter (1:5). The writer quotes the Greek Jeremiah, which says "Lord", as in 7:21. "새 언약" is the wording of the Lord's Supper in the Korean Gospels, which this prophecy stands behind (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: Eis que
decisions.reason: "Eis" is still the written Portuguese word that calls for attention, without the archaic ring English "behold" has, so Literal keeps it; Balanced and Readable leave it untranslated, as the English.

decisions.choice: {{gender:os antepassados|os pais}}
decisions.reason: Portuguese "os pais" can mean parents, but here it would be read as the forefathers; the setting follows the English, with "antepassados" as the inclusive default.

decisions.choice: አዲስ ኪዳን (a new covenant)
decisions.reason: The new covenant of Jeremiah is አዲስ ኪዳን at every level; that the same words also name the New Testament in Amharic is part of the point, as with the English.

source.text: ὅτι αὕτη ἡ διαθήκη ἣν διαθήσομαι τῷ οἴκῳ Ἰσραὴλ μετὰ τὰς ἡμέρας ἐκείνας, λέγει κύριος, διδοὺς νόμους μου εἰς τὴν διάνοιαν αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐπὶ καρδίας αὐτῶν ἐπιγράψω αὐτούς, καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς εἰς θεόν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔσονταί μοι εἰς λαόν.

records.literal_gloss: For this the covenant which I will covenant to the house of Israel after the days those, says Lord, giving laws of me into the mind of them, and upon hearts of them I will write them, and I will be to them for God, and they will be to me for people.

en.L: "For this [is] the covenant that I will covenant with the house of Israel after those days, says [the] Lord: putting {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws into their mind, I will also write them on their hearts, and I will be to them as God, and they will be to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as a people."
en.B: "For this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel when those days are past, says the Lord: I will place {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws in their understanding and inscribe them on their hearts. I will be God to them, and they will be a people to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.R: "Here is the covenant I will make with Israel when that time comes, says the Lord: I will place {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws in their minds, and I will write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people."

es.L: «Porque este [es] el pacto que pactaré con la casa de Israel después de aquellos días, dice [el] Señor: poniendo {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes en su mente, también las escribiré en sus corazones; y seré para ellos como Dios, y ellos serán para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} como pueblo».
es.B: «Porque este es el pacto que haré con la casa de Israel cuando hayan pasado aquellos días, dice el Señor: pondré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes en su entendimiento y las grabaré en sus corazones. Yo seré Dios para ellos, y ellos serán un pueblo para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}».
es.R: «Este es el pacto que haré con Israel cuando llegue ese tiempo, dice el Señor: pondré {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes en su mente, y las escribiré en su corazón. Yo seré su Dios, y ellos serán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo».

fr.L: « Car voici l’alliance que je conclurai avec la maison d’Israël après ces jours-là, dit [le] Seigneur : mettant {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois dans leur pensée, je les écrirai aussi sur leurs cœurs, et je serai pour eux Dieu, et ils seront pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} un peuple. »
fr.B: « Voici en effet l’alliance que je conclurai avec la maison d’Israël quand ces jours-là seront passés, dit le Seigneur : je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois dans leur intelligence et je les graverai sur leur cœur. Je serai Dieu pour eux, et ils seront un peuple pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. »
fr.R: « Voici l’alliance que je ferai avec Israël quand ce temps viendra, dit le Seigneur : je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois dans leur esprit, et je les écrirai dans leur cœur. Je serai leur Dieu, et ils seront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple. »

sw.L: "Kwa maana hili [ndilo] agano nitakaloagana na nyumba ya Israeli baada ya siku hizo, anasema Bwana: nikitia sheria {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} katika akili zao, pia nitaziandika juu ya mioyo yao, nami nitakuwa kwao kama Mungu, nao watakuwa {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}} kama watu."
sw.B: "Kwa maana hili ndilo agano nitakalofanya na nyumba ya Israeli siku hizo zikiisha kupita, anasema Bwana: nitaweka sheria {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} katika fahamu zao na kuziandika juu ya mioyo yao. Mimi nitakuwa Mungu kwao, nao watakuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}."
sw.R: "Hili ndilo agano nitakalofanya na Israeli wakati huo utakapofika, anasema Bwana: nitaweka sheria {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} akilini mwao, na kuziandika mioyoni mwao. Nitakuwa Mungu wao, nao watakuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}."

vi.L: "Vì đây [là] giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lập với nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên sau những ngày ấy, Chúa phán: {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt luật pháp của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vào trí họ, và cũng sẽ ghi chúng trên lòng họ; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và họ sẽ là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.B: "Vì đây là giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lập với nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên khi những ngày ấy qua đi, Chúa phán: {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt luật pháp của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vào trí hiểu biết của họ và khắc ghi trên lòng họ. Ta sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và họ sẽ là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.R: "Đây là giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lập với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên khi thời ấy đến, Chúa phán: {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đặt luật pháp của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vào tâm trí họ, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ viết luật ấy trên lòng họ. Ta sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và họ sẽ là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."

ko.L: "그 날들 뒤에 내가 이스라엘 집과 맺을 언약은 이것이다, 주님께서 말씀하신다. 내가 내 율법들을 그들의 생각에 넣어 주고, 그들의 마음에 그것들을 기록할 것이다. 그리고 나는 그들에게 하나님이 되고, 그들은 나에게 백성이 될 것이다."
ko.B: "그날들이 지난 뒤에 내가 이스라엘 집과 맺을 언약은 이것이다. 주님께서 말씀하신다. 나는 내 율법을 그들의 생각 속에 두고, 그들의 마음에 새겨 줄 것이다. 나는 그들에게 하나님이 되고, 그들은 나에게 백성이 될 것이다."
ko.R: "그때가 오면 내가 이스라엘과 맺을 언약은 이것이다. 주님께서 말씀하신다. 나는 내 율법을 그들의 생각 속에 두고, 그들의 마음에 새겨 줄 것이다. 나는 그들의 하나님이 되고, 그들은 내 백성이 될 것이다."

pt.L: "Pois esta [é] a aliança que firmarei com a casa de Israel depois daqueles dias, diz [o] Senhor: pondo as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} leis na mente deles, também as escreverei sobre os corações deles; e serei para eles como Deus, e eles serão para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} como povo."
pt.B: "Pois esta é a aliança que farei com a casa de Israel quando aqueles dias tiverem passado, diz o Senhor: porei as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} leis no entendimento deles e as gravarei no coração deles. Eu serei Deus para eles, e eles serão um povo para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}."
pt.R: "Esta é a aliança que vou fazer com Israel quando chegar esse tempo, diz o Senhor: vou pôr as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} leis na mente deles e vou escrevê-las no coração deles. Eu serei o Deus deles, e eles serão o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo."

decisions.choice: Jeremiah 31:33 (38:33 Greek)
decisions.reason: The quotation of Jeremiah 31 continues. Where Hebrews has κύριος ("Lord"), the Hebrew of Jeremiah has the divine name, YHWH. The Hebrew has "I will put my law (singular, torah) within them"; the Greek has the plural "laws" and "into their mind".

decisions.choice: the law written on the heart: God himself will give his people an inward will to know and do what he commands
decisions.reason: Under the first covenant the law was written on tablets of stone (Exodus 24:12; 2 Corinthians 3:3). In the new covenant God puts it within his people, so that they keep it from the heart (Ezekiel 36:26-27). The change is not of God's will but of where it is written.

decisions.choice: I will be their God and they will be my people: the covenant formula
decisions.reason: This formula expresses the heart of every covenant between God and Israel (Exodus 6:7; Leviticus 26:12). The Greek construction "be to them for God" is a Hebrew idiom for "be their God".

decisions.choice: covenant: the verb διατίθεμαι is from the same root as διαθήκη
decisions.reason: The Greek says literally "the covenant that I will covenant". Literal keeps the repetition.

decisions.choice: make
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "make a covenant", the usual English.

decisions.choice: I will be God to them, and they will be a people to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}
alternatives: I will be their God, and they will be my people
decisions.reason: Balanced follows the Greek word order of the covenant formula. Readable uses the more familiar form, which says the same thing.

decisions.choice: pactaré (Literal); haré (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the verb from the same root as "pacto", as the Greek does (meaning decision m4); Balanced and Readable use the ordinary verb, as the English does (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: agano nitakaloagana
decisions.reason: "Kuagana" is built on "agano", so Literal keeps the repetition the meaning decision notes; Balanced and Readable say "kufanya agano", the usual phrase.

decisions.choice: l’alliance que je conclurai
alternatives: l’alliance par laquelle je ferai alliance
decisions.reason: French has no verb formed from "alliance", so Literal cannot repeat the root as the Greek and the English Literal do (meaning decision m4); "conclure une alliance" is the usual French expression.

decisions.choice: "Đây là giao ước Ta sẽ lập với ...", the wording of the Vietnamese Romans (11:27) for the same verse of Jeremiah
decisions.reason: Romans quotes Jeremiah 31:33 in part (meaning decision there), so Vietnamese keeps its wording, "giao ước Ta sẽ lập với", and continues in the same voice. The covenant formula keeps "Ta sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và họ sẽ là dân của Ta" at every level (m3).

decisions.choice: "맺을 언약" for "the covenant I will covenant" (L)
decisions.reason: The verb shares its root with "covenant" (meaning decision); Korean has no verb from "언약", so Literal uses the verb that goes with it, "맺다", as the other levels do.

decisions.choice: a aliança que firmarei
decisions.reason: Portuguese has no verb from "aliança", so Literal cannot keep the repetition the English keeps (m4); "o pacto que pactuarei" would keep it only by giving up "aliança", the book's word for the covenant.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah 31:34 (38:34 Greek)
decisions.reason: The quotation of Jeremiah 31 continues. In the words "Know the Lord" (κύριον) the Hebrew has the divine name, YHWH.

decisions.choice: fellow citizen
decisions.reason: SBLGNT reads πολίτην ("fellow citizen"), as do the oldest manuscripts. Later manuscripts, followed by the traditional printed text, read "neighbor". Reviewers must check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: all will know me: knowing God directly and personally, not only by instruction from others
alternatives: teaching will no longer be needed in the church
decisions.reason: To "know" God in Jeremiah is to live in a right relationship with him (Jeremiah 22:15-16). The promise is that every member of the covenant people, from least to greatest, will know him. It does not forbid teaching (Hebrews itself teaches, 5:12); it says no one will be outside that knowledge.

decisions.choice: brother: a fellow member of the people, man or woman
decisions.reason: Here ἀδελφὸν means a fellow Israelite, parallel to "fellow citizen".

decisions.choice: a neighbor or a relative
alternatives: a fellow citizen or a brother
decisions.reason: Readable uses everyday words for the two kinds of people one would teach.

decisions.choice: su hermano, no setting
decisions.reason: Here "hermano" is any fellow member of the people, man or woman (meaning decision m4), as Spanish says of a generic member of a group; as with "hermanos", it takes no gender span. Spanish "su" is not marked for gender, so the English span on "their" has no counterpart.

decisions.choice: raia mwenzake; ndugu yake; no setting
alternatives: ndugu yake wa kiume au wa kike
decisions.reason: "Mwenzake" and "yake" mean his or her, and "ndugu" is a brother or a sister, so the English gender spans have no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: chacun son concitoyen, with no gender span
alternatives: chacun {{gender:son concitoyen ou sa concitoyenne|son concitoyen}}
decisions.reason: The English Literal needs a span for "their/his"; the French possessive "son" is the same for a man or a woman, so only "frère" (meaning decision m4) takes a gender span.

decisions.choice: "anh em hay chị em mình" (L, B), plain text, against the English gender span
alternatives: the gender span for "anh chị em"
decisions.reason: The brother here is any fellow member of the people, man or woman (m4). With the possessive "mình", Vietnamese "anh em hay chị em" reads naturally and leaves nothing for the setting to change; the style guide keeps the span for adelphoi addressed or named as believers.

decisions.choice: የአገሩን ሰው (his fellow citizen) without a span; {{gender:ወንድሙን ወይም እኅቱን|ወንድሙን}}
decisions.reason: The Amharic masculine suffix on "each" is generic and needs no span; brother, which here means a fellow member of the people, man or woman (meaning decision m4), has the span with the suffix and object marker inside each option.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah 31:34 (38:34 Greek)
decisions.reason: The last words of the quotation. The Hebrew reads "I will forgive their iniquity, and their sin I will remember no more"; the Greek says "I will be merciful toward their wrongs". The author repeats these words in 10:17, where he draws the conclusion: where sins are forgiven, no more offering for sin is needed (10:18).

decisions.choice: their sins (without "and their lawless deeds")
alternatives: their sins and their lawless deeds
decisions.reason: SBLGNT has "their sins" only. Many later manuscripts, followed by the traditional printed text, add "and their lawless deeds", probably from 10:17. Reviewers must check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: merciful: gracious, ready to forgive
decisions.reason: ἵλεως ("gracious, merciful") is related to the verb Hebrews uses for making atonement in 2:17. To be merciful toward wrongs is to forgive them.

decisions.choice: I will not remember their sins: I will not hold them against them any more
decisions.reason: When God "remembers" sins in Scripture he acts on them in judgment (Psalm 25:7; Hosea 8:13). Not remembering them means they are no longer held against the people.

decisions.choice: I will forgive
decisions.reason: Readable states what being merciful toward wrongs means.

decisions.choice: "sự bất chính" (L, B); "những điều sai trái" (R)
decisions.reason: Unrighteous deeds are from the righteousness family; "bất chính" keeps the pair with "công chính", as in the Vietnamese Romans (1:18), and Readable says it plainly, as there.

source.text: ἐν τῷ λέγειν Καινὴν πεπαλαίωκεν τὴν πρώτην, τὸ δὲ παλαιούμενον καὶ γηράσκον ἐγγὺς ἀφανισμοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: In the to say New he has made old the first; the [thing] and being made old and aging [is] near vanishing.

en.L: By saying "new," {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made the first old; and what is being made old and is aging [is] near disappearing.
en.B: By calling the covenant "new," {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has treated the first as old, and what grows old and worn out is close to vanishing.
en.R: When God called this covenant "new," {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} showed that the first covenant was old. And anything that is getting old and worn out will soon disappear.

es.L: Al decir «nuevo», {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha dado por viejo al primero; y lo que se está volviendo viejo y envejece [está] cerca de desaparecer.
es.B: Al llamar «nuevo» al pacto, ha tratado al primero como viejo, y lo que se vuelve viejo y gastado está a punto de desaparecer.
es.R: Cuando Dios llamó «nuevo» a este pacto, mostró que el primer pacto era viejo. Y todo lo que se está volviendo viejo y gastado pronto desaparecerá.

fr.L: En disant « nouvelle », {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rendu ancienne la première ; or ce qui devient ancien et vieillit [est] près de disparaître.
fr.B: En appelant l’alliance « nouvelle », {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a traité la première comme ancienne, et ce qui vieillit et s’use est près de disparaître.
fr.R: Quand Dieu a appelé cette alliance « nouvelle », {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a montré que la première alliance était ancienne. Et tout ce qui devient vieux et usé va bientôt disparaître.

sw.L: Kwa kusema "jipya," amelifanya lile la kwanza kuwa la zamani; na kile kinachofanywa kuwa cha zamani na kinachozeeka [kiko] karibu kutoweka.
sw.B: Kwa kuliita agano "jipya," amelihesabu lile la kwanza kuwa la zamani, na kitu kinachozeeka na kuchakaa kiko karibu kutoweka.
sw.R: Mungu alipoliita agano hili "jipya," alionyesha kwamba agano la kwanza ni la zamani. Na kitu chochote kinachozeeka na kuchakaa kitatoweka hivi karibuni.

vi.L: Khi phán "mới", {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho giao ước thứ nhất thành cũ; mà điều gì đang trở nên cũ và già cỗi thì gần biến mất.
vi.B: Khi gọi giao ước ấy là "mới", {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã xem giao ước thứ nhất là cũ, và điều gì đã cũ kỹ và già cỗi thì sắp biến mất.
vi.R: Khi Đức Chúa Trời gọi giao ước này là "mới", {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho thấy giao ước thứ nhất đã cũ. Và điều gì đang trở nên cũ kỹ và già cỗi thì chẳng bao lâu sẽ biến mất.

ko.L: "새"라고 말씀하심으로써 그분은 첫 [언약]을 낡은 것으로 만드셨습니다. 그리고 낡아지고 오래된 것은 곧 사라지게 됩니다.
ko.B: 하나님께서 이 언약을 "새" 언약이라고 부르심으로써 첫 언약을 낡은 것으로 여기셨습니다. 낡고 오래된 것은 곧 사라지게 마련입니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 이 언약을 "새" 언약이라고 부르셨을 때, 첫 언약은 낡았다는 것을 보여 주셨습니다. 그리고 낡고 오래된 것은 무엇이든 곧 사라질 것입니다.

pt.L: Ao dizer "nova", {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tornou antiga a primeira; e o que está se tornando antigo e envelhecendo [está] perto de desaparecer.
pt.B: Ao chamar a aliança de "nova", {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tratou a primeira como antiga; e o que envelhece e se desgasta está perto de desaparecer.
pt.R: Quando Deus chamou essa aliança de "nova", {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mostrou que a primeira aliança era velha. E tudo o que está ficando velho e gasto logo vai desaparecer.

am.L: «አዲስ» በማለቱ የፊተኛውን አሮጌ አድርጎታል፤ የሚያረጀውና የሚሸመግለውም ለመጥፋት ቅርብ ነው።
am.B: ኪዳኑን «አዲስ» ብሎ በመጥራቱ የመጀመሪያውን እንደ አሮጌ ቆጥሮታል፤ የሚያረጅና የሚደክም ደግሞ ለመጥፋት የቀረበ ነው።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ይህን ኪዳን «አዲስ» ብሎ ሲጠራው፣ የመጀመሪያው ኪዳን አሮጌ መሆኑን አሳየ። የሚያረጅና የሚያልቅ ነገር ሁሉ ደግሞ በቅርቡ ይጠፋል።

decisions.choice: made old: declared outdated, treated as old
decisions.reason: πεπαλαίωκεν means to make or declare old. By naming a "new" (Καινὴν) covenant, God marked the first one as old. The same verb in the next clause (παλαιούμενον) and γηράσκον ("growing aged") describe what is near its end.

decisions.choice: near vanishing: the first covenant is passing away now that the new one has come
decisions.reason: The author says it is "near" disappearing, not that it has gone. Its end began when the new covenant was announced and has come with Christ. Whether the author also thought of the end of the temple worship is not said.

decisions.choice: the covenant; this covenant
decisions.reason: The word "covenant" is understood from the quotation; Balanced and Readable supply it.

decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who spoke.
